subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Delighted
solution:
The correct answer is: **Joyful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Delighted"** means feeling or showing great pleasure. (प्रसन्न)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **delighted **to receive the award for her hard work.
 
 
 
• **"Joyful"** refers to feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness. (आनंदित)
 
 
• **Example: **The **joyful **children ran around the park, laughing and playing games.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Delighted'** is **'Joyful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Angry **(गुस्से में): Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

 
 
• **Example:** He was **angry **when he found out that someone had stolen his bike.
 
 
 
• **Confused **(उलझन में): Unable to think clearly; bewildered.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt **confused **by the complex instructions given by the teacher.
 
 
 
• **Sad** (दुखी): Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.
 
 
• **Example:** He was **sad **to hear about the passing of his old friend.
